name: Vedic Astro Reading
description: Dispatch a birth place/date/time to vedic_astro/'s 6-agent deep prediction engine (over its running HTTP server) and return the full multi-section reading.
purpose: The Central Orchestrator needs one uniform, typed way to hand birth data to vedic_astro/'s existing chart + reading pipeline. vedic_astro/ owns a bare top-level agents/ package that collides with brain/'s own internals if imported into the same process, so this skill reaches it over HTTP instead of importing it (D20), implementing the app's own geocode->reading sequence as internal glue rather than as two separate skills (H-O4).
